description: Call this when a user asks a specific question about migrating a legacy IIS, classic ASP or SQL Server website, such as cost, downtime or what happens to the database. Returns published Q&As word for word, filtered by `query`. `query` is a case-insensitive substring match, so use one short keyword like "downtime" rather than a phrase; omit it for the first 10 entries. For an overview of rehost, rebuild and replace, use get_migration_paths instead.

query.description: Optional. Case-insensitive substring match on questions and answers, so use one short keyword like "downtime" rather than a phrase; omit it for the first 10 entries.

name: get_faq
title: Migration FAQ
